specimen_label: histology slide image A and slide image B
transcribed_question:
1) Identify the slides A & B
2) Mention two places where A can be found

marker.description: Arrow/pointer on slide A pointing to the cartilage-like tissue

main_question: Identify the slides A and B, and mention two places where A can be found.
main_answer: Slide A: hyaline cartilage. Slide B: compact bone.
main_explanation: Slide A shows a glassy cartilage matrix with chondrocytes in lacunae, consistent with hyaline cartilage. Slide B shows layered eosinophilic lamellae and bony architecture consistent with compact bone. Hyaline cartilage is found, for example, in the tracheal rings and the articular surfaces of synovial joints.

supporting_question.question: Which cell type is responsible for maintaining the matrix of slide A?
supporting_question.explanation: Chondrocytes maintain the cartilage matrix in hyaline cartilage.

true_false.statement: Hyaline cartilage is found in the tracheal rings and articular surfaces of synovial joints.
true_false.explanation: These are classic locations of hyaline cartilage.
